subject: Exactly as in the start frame, unchanged in every respect. The product is worn on the right knee, already fully and correctly in place: its notch cups the kneecap's lower border, no gap, the equal peaks flanking it, sitting slim and flush against the body with the wordmark horizontal and readable. The rigid shell stays on the front of the knee throughout, never rotating around the leg.

camera.movement: Held low in front of her knee and backing down the stairs ahead of her at her pace, easing slowly back and up so her hand sliding down the rail comes into view; always in front of the knee, never orbiting. Low breath sway.
camera.framing: As in the start frame, the knee and strap in the middle of the frame.

motion: She walks down the stairs: her right foot steps down onto the next stair, then her left foot steps down onto the one below, two clear steps down in the clip, the knee bending as it takes her weight each time and her body lowering with each step. Her hand slides down the brass rail beside her as she goes. The material compresses into the flesh with a shallow indentation above and below the contact line, flattening over bone and denting into the soft tissue either side — never a clean circle. Skin slightly paler underneath, faint pink at the compressed edge. Rigid element flush with a tight contact shadow beneath, no gap. Everything in frame keeps the exact form, proportion and count it has in the start frame, first frame to last — nothing melts, merges, splits, grows or becomes something else. The knee and strap stay in frame throughout. The product keeps the start frame's exact geometry every frame: same silhouette, same two matching peaks of equal height, same notch, same band width, same hardware and wordmark position. The rigid shell never bends, flexes or stretches from any angle.
